papers.title: Prognostic impact of late left ventricular reverse remodeling in heart failure with reduced ejection fraction
papers.translated_title: 晚期左心室逆重构对射血分数降低型心力衰竭的预后影响
papers.author: Ikesugi, H.
papers.summary: Left ventricular reverse remodeling (LVRR) is associated with favorable outcomes in heart failure with reduced ejection fraction (HFrEF), but the prognostic significance of LVRR first documented beyond 24 months has not been fully characterized in patients with diverse etiologies. We retrospectively studied 213 patients with HFrEF (baseline left ventricular ejection fraction [LVEF] <=40%) who underwent echocardiography at baseline and in two prespecified follow-up windows: 6 to less than 24 months (Follow-up 1) and 24-78 months (Follow-up 2). LVRR was defined as an absolute increase in LVEF of >=10 percentage points and a follow-up LVEF >40%. Patients were classified as Early LVRR (first meeting the criteria at Follow-up 1; n = 84), Late LVRR (first meeting the criteria at Follow-up 2; n = 25), or No-LVRR (not meeting the criteria at either follow-up; n = 104). The primary endpoint was a composite of all-cause mortality and heart failure hospitalization, assessed from Follow-up 2. Over a median follow-up of 33.8 months, 52 patients died and 32 were hospitalized for heart failure. In multivariable Cox regression adjusted for age, sex, and ischemic heart disease, both Early and Late LVRR were associated with a lower risk of the primary endpoint than No-LVRR (hazard ratio [HR] 0.299, 95% confidence interval [CI] 0.164-0.544, and HR 0.293, 95% CI 0.115-0.744, respectively). These associations remained significant in alternative models adjusted for diabetes mellitus, estimated glomerular filtration rate, or heart failure duration. Kaplan-Meier analyses showed better event-free survival for the composite endpoint and higher overall survival in both LVRR groups than in the No-LVRR group, whereas significantly better HF hospitalization-free survival was observed only in the Early LVRR group. The mean Simple-GDMT Score, reflecting guideline-directed medical therapy (GDMT) intensity, increased from baseline to Follow-up 1 in all three groups, but a further significant increase from Follow-up 1 to Follow-up 2 was observed only in the Late LVRR group. In multivariable linear regression, greater increases in GDMT intensity were associated with higher LVEF at Follow-up 2 (beta coefficient 1.265, 95% CI 0.237-2.293). Late LVRR was associated with favorable clinical outcomes, and greater longitudinal GDMT intensification was associated with higher LVEF at Follow-up 2, although causal relationships cannot be established from this observational study.
papers.translated_summary: 左心室逆重构（LVRR）与射血分数降低的心力衰竭（HFrEF）患者的良好预后相关，但首次记录于24个月之后的LVRR在不同病因患者中的预后意义尚未得到充分描述。我们回顾性研究了213例HFrEF患者（基线左心室射血分数[LVEF]≤40%），这些患者在基线和两个预设随访窗口接受了超声心动图检查：6至不足24个月（随访1）和24至78个月（随访2）。LVRR定义为LVEF绝对增加≥10个百分点且随访LVEF>40%。患者被分类为早期LVRR（在随访1首次符合标准；n=84）、晚期LVRR（在随访2首次符合标准；n=25）或无LVRR（在两次随访中均不符合标准；n=104）。主要终点为全因死亡和心力衰竭住院的复合终点，从随访2开始评估。在中位随访33.8个月期间，52例患者死亡，32例因心力衰竭住院。在调整年龄、性别和缺血性心脏病的多变量Cox回归中，早期和晚期LVRR均与主要终点风险低于无LVRR相关（风险比[HR] 0.299，95%置信区间[CI] 0.164-0.544，以及HR 0.293，95% CI 0.115-0.744）。这些关联在调整糖尿病、估算肾小球滤过率或心力衰竭病程的替代模型中仍然显著。Kaplan-Meier分析显示，两个LVRR组的复合终点无事件生存率和总生存率均优于无LVRR组，而仅在早期LVRR组中观察到显著更好的无心力衰竭住院生存率。反映指南导向药物治疗（GDMT）强度的平均Simple-GDMT评分在三组中均从基线至随访1增加，但仅在晚期LVRR组中观察到从随访1至随访2的进一步显著增加。在多变量线性回归中，GDMT强度增加幅度较大与随访2时较高的LVEF相关（β系数1.265，95% CI 0.237-2.293）。晚期LVRR与良好的临床结局相关，纵向GDMT强化程度较大与随访2时较高的LVEF相关，尽管本观察性研究无法确定因果关系。

papers.title: Alzheimers disease blood biomarkers reveal proteomic modules of disease progression
papers.translated_title: 阿尔茨海默病血液生物标志物揭示疾病进展的蛋白质组模块
papers.author: Butler, R. R.
papers.summary: Alzheimer's disease (AD) unfolds over decades preceding cognitive symptoms, and measuring the full scope of its molecular complexity remains difficult. Blood-based biomarkers of amyloid, phosphorylated tau, astrocytic reactivity and neuroaxonal injury including A{beta}42/40, p-tau181, p-tau217, GFAP and NfL enable scalable assessment of AD-related pathology and associated processes but capture only a narrow slice of the systemic biology ultimately shaping disease progression. Here we link these increasingly routine clinical assays to the plasma proteome using multi-omic linear modeling to resolve functional heterogeneity in AD progression. In 484 older adults spanning normal cognition, mild cognitive impairment (MCI) and AD, we derived proteomic signatures for each key biomarker across more than 6,000 proteins, uncovering overlapping and distinct biological processes and cell types implicated in AD with robust signal across proteomic modalities. From these we built continuous progression-focused functional modules that were consistently preserved across 12 independent cohorts comprising 11,042 participants from the Global Neurodegeneration Proteomics Consortium and that associated with cognitive decline, diagnosis and AD-relevant biology. A synaptic vesicle module marked apparent neuronal resilience as much as 5 years before estimated symptom onset. We show routine and accessible plasma measures can be leveraged to recover reproducible, biologically distinct progression modules that improve characterization of heterogeneous AD and have practical value for risk stratification, trial enrichment, or treatment monitoring.
papers.translated_summary: 阿尔茨海默病（AD）在认知症状出现前数十年即已展开，而测量其分子复杂性的全貌仍然困难。淀粉样蛋白、磷酸化tau、星形胶质细胞反应性及神经轴索损伤的血液生物标志物，包括Aβ42/40、p-tau181、p-tau217、GFAP和NfL，使得对AD相关病理及相关过程的可扩展评估成为可能，但这些标志物仅捕获最终塑造疾病进展的系统性生物学的狭窄切片。在此，我们通过多组学线性建模将这些日益常规的临床检测与血浆蛋白质组相关联，以解析AD进展中的功能异质性。在涵盖正常认知、轻度认知障碍（MCI）和AD的484名老年人中，我们针对每种关键生物标志物在超过6,000种蛋白质中衍生了蛋白质组特征，揭示了与AD相关的重叠和独特的生物学过程及细胞类型，并在多种蛋白质组学模态中具有稳健信号。基于这些特征，我们构建了以进展为重点的连续功能模块，这些模块在来自全球神经退行性疾病蛋白质组学联盟的12个独立队列（共11,042名参与者）中一致保持，并与认知下降、诊断及AD相关生物学相关联。一个突触囊泡模块在估计症状发作前长达5年即标记出明显的神经元韧性。我们表明，常规且可及的血浆测量可用于恢复可重复的、生物学上独特的进展模块，这些模块改善了对异质性AD的表征，并在风险分层、试验富集或治疗监测方面具有实用价值。

papers.title: Adjusting for medication status in genome-wide association studies
papers.translated_title: 在全基因组关联研究中校正用药状态
papers.author: Chong, A. H. W.
papers.summary: When conducting genome-wide association studies, addressing medication status that is relevant to the trait of interest can prevent biases that could distort estimates of the true genetic effect. Here, we introduce the genetic empirical medication reduction adjustment (GEMRA) method which uses a heuristic search for an empirical adjustment to be applied to phenotypic values of participants reporting medication use. Through simulations we show that the direct genetic effect estimates in the GEMRA approach exhibited less bias and greater statistical power than common strategies such as including medication as a covariate, restricting the sample to unmedicated users or including all samples without adjustment. We then applied the GEMRA approach to estimate statin medication adjustment for analysis of low-density lipoprotein (LDL) cholesterol levels and antihypertensive medication adjustment for analyses of systolic (SBP) and diastolic (DBP) blood pressure using multi-population data from UK Biobank and the Uganda Genome Resource. We found that a relative rather than an absolute adjustment better modelled the effect of medication on LDL cholesterol, SBP and DBP, with an effect of 40%, 10% and 10% reduction appearing to be consistent across populations, respectively. We also show that spurious differences in medication effects across populations can arise when the effect scale is misspecified.
papers.translated_summary: 在进行全基因组关联研究时，处理与目标性状相关的用药状态可以防止可能扭曲真实遗传效应估计的偏倚。在此，我们介绍遗传经验用药缩减调整（GEMRA）方法，该方法使用启发式搜索来获得应用于报告用药参与者的表型值的经验调整。通过模拟，我们表明GEMRA方法中的直接遗传效应估计比常见策略（如将用药作为协变量纳入、将样本限制为未用药者或纳入所有样本而不进行调整）表现出更少的偏倚和更大的统计功效。然后，我们应用GEMRA方法，利用来自UK Biobank和Uganda Genome Resource的多群体数据，估计用于低密度脂蛋白（LDL）胆固醇水平分析的他汀类药物用药调整，以及用于收缩压（SBP）和舒张压（DBP）血压分析的反高血压药物用药调整。我们发现，相对调整而非绝对调整能更好地建模药物对LDL胆固醇、SBP和DBP的影响，分别出现40%、10%和10%的缩减效应在不同群体间似乎一致。我们还表明，当效应尺度设定错误时，可能会出现跨群体用药效应的虚假差异。

papers.title: Real-World Adaptation and External Validation of Machine-Learning Impedance Spectroscopy for Immediate Postpartum Detection of Obstetric Anal Sphincter Injuries
papers.translated_title: 机器学习阻抗谱在产后即刻检测产科肛门括约肌损伤中的真实世界适应性与外部验证
papers.author: Mlynczak, M.
papers.summary: Obstetric anal sphincter injury (OASI) requires immediate postpartum recognition for primary repair. Diagnosis relies primarily on clinical examination, as endoanal ultrasound (EAUS) is rarely a bedside option. Therefore, objective diagnostic assessment is most needed during the first postpartum hours. However, it is challenging to obtain the anatomically verified data needed to develop diagnostic technologies for this clinical window. We evaluated the translation of a machine-learning-assisted impedance spectroscopy model into its intended immediate postpartum setting. The model lifecycle comprised three sequential phases: V1 development using anatomically verified data from a prospective multicenter study (N=152); V2 real-world adaptation, comprising post-market data collection, retraining (N=144) to adapt to acute physiological tissue changes, and subsequent separate evaluation (N=125); and prospective external validation of V2 in an unseen cohort (N=70). During this separate evaluation, V2 achieved 89.6% accuracy. In external validation, all examinations occurred within 4 hours of birth (94.3% within the first hour). Against subsequent EAUS, V2 achieved 86.2% sensitivity, 92.7% specificity, and 90.0% overall accuracy. The V2 model was prospectively externally validated in its intended immediate-postpartum setting, supporting ML-assisted impedance spectroscopy as an objective adjunct, and not a replacement, to clinical OASI assessment. Further validation is required to confirm generalizability.
papers.translated_summary: 产科肛门括约肌损伤（OASI）需要在产后立即识别以进行一期修复。诊断主要依赖临床检查，因为肛门内超声（EAUS）很少能作为床旁选择。因此，产后最初数小时是最需要客观诊断评估的时段。然而，要开发针对这一临床窗口的诊断技术，难以获得经解剖学验证的数据。我们评估了机器学习辅助的阻抗谱模型向其预期产后即时应用场景的转化。该模型生命周期包括三个连续阶段：V1开发阶段，使用来自前瞻性多中心研究（N=152）的经解剖学验证数据；V2真实世界适应阶段，包括上市后数据收集、重新训练（N=144）以适应急性生理性组织变化，以及随后单独评估（N=125）；以及V2在未见队列（N=70）中的前瞻性外部验证。在此单独评估中，V2达到89.6%的准确率。在外部验证中，所有检查均在出生后4小时内完成（94.3%在出生后第一小时内）。与随后的EAUS相比，V2达到86.2%的敏感性、92.7%的特异性和90.0%的总体准确率。V2模型在其预期的产后即时应用场景中进行了前瞻性外部验证，支持机器学习辅助的阻抗谱作为临床OASI评估的客观辅助手段，而非替代手段。仍需进一步验证以确认其普遍适用性。

papers.title: Endocrine and well-being profiles shape psychosexual health and psychophysiological symptoms after menopause
papers.translated_title: 内分泌与健康状况塑造绝经后心理性健康及心理生理症状
papers.author: Denninger, A. F.
papers.summary: Menopause is a major neuroendocrine transition characterised by substantial changes in endocrine milieu, physiological, psychological, and psychosexual health. Although menopausal symptoms are common, their range and severity vary considerably between individuals, suggesting that menopause is a multifaceted process. Endocrine markers (luteinising, follicle-stimulating & anti-Mullerian hormone), together with perceived well-being, may contribute to this variability. Thus, the aim was to capture the complex impact of endocrine and well-being markers on psychosexual health and menopausal symptoms. Therefore, we first applied principal component analyses to identify individual endocrine and well-being profiles, to then assess their association with psychosexual health and menopausal symptoms in pre- and post-menopausal females. Post- compared to pre-menopausal females report reduced psychosexual health and greater urogenital and psychological menopausal symptom burden. Endocrine and well-being profiles interact with reproductive status: Post-menopausal females with lower subjective well-being and a stronger menopause-like endocrine milieu report decreased overall psychosexual health and more sexual related pain. Additionally, endocrine milieu interacted with reproductive status on urogenital symptoms: Post-menopausal females with a stronger menopause-like endocrine milieu report less urogenital symptoms. Together, these findings suggest that endocrine factors and subjective well-being jointly influence psychosexual health and menopausal symptoms after menopause. No association is seen before menopause. Therefore, females after menopause need to be considered separatelyin research and clinic. Multivariate analyses capture patterns that are not identified using individual biomarkers and conventional univariate approaches. Our findings highlight the value of integrative multivariate approaches for improving the assessment of menopausal health and characterising individual variability across the menopausal transition. papers.translated_summary: 绝经是一个重要的神经内分泌转变过程，其特征是内分泌环境、生理、心理及性心理健康发生显著变化。尽管绝经症状较为常见，但其范围和严重程度在个体间差异很大，提示绝经是一个多层面的过程。内分泌标志物（促黄体生成素、促卵泡激素和抗苗勒管激素）以及感知健康状况可能 contribute to 这种变异性。因此，本研究旨在捕捉内分泌与健康状况标志物对性心理健康及绝经症状的复杂影响。为此，我们首先应用主成分分析来识别个体内分泌与健康状况特征，进而评估其与绝经前和绝经后女性性心理健康及绝经症状的关联。与绝经前女性相比，绝经后女性报告性心理健康降低，泌尿生殖系统和心理绝经症状负担更重。内分泌与健康状况特征与生殖状态存在交互作用：主观健康状况较低且内分泌环境更接近绝经状态的绝经后女性，报告整体性心理健康下降及更多性相关疼痛。此外，内分泌环境与生殖状态在泌尿生殖系统症状上存在交互作用：内分泌环境更接近绝经状态的绝经后女性报告较少的泌尿生殖系统症状。综上，这些发现提示内分泌因素与主观健康状况共同影响绝经后女性的性心理健康和绝经症状。绝经前未见此种关联。因此，绝经后女性在研究和临床中需被单独考虑。多变量分析能够捕捉使用单一生物标志物和传统单变量方法无法识别的模式。我们的发现凸显了整合性多变量方法在改善绝经健康评估及刻画绝经过渡期个体变异性方面的价值。研究亮点：绝经后性心理健康、泌尿生殖系统及心理绝经症状加重；绝经女性健康状况较好，且影响性心理健康；内分泌环境在绝经后影响泌尿生殖系统症状和性心理健康；内分泌环境与性心理健康的关联在绝经前后不同；为改善绝经健康研究，多变量方法是必要的。

papers.title: Effects of a standardized saffron extract (Safr'Inside™) on menopause-related symptoms: a randomised, double-blind, placebo-controlled trial in perimenopausal women
papers.translated_title: 标准化藏红花提取物（Safr'Inside™）对绝经相关症状的影响：一项针对围绝经期女性的随机、双盲、安慰剂对照试验
papers.author: Sultana, R.
papers.summary: Menopausal symptoms, which may emerge during perimenopause and include psychological, somatic, vasomotor, and sleep-related disturbances, can substantially impair women's well-being and quality of life. Saffron (Crocus sativus L.) has emerged as a promising non-hormonal nutritional approach, with potential benefits for emotional wellbeing and stress-related symptoms. This study evaluated the efficacy and safety of Safr'Inside, a standardized saffron extract, in perimenopausal women. This multicentre, randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled trial enrolled 104 healthy perimenopausal women (mean age: 45.7 {+/-} 3.7 years) receiving Safr'Inside (30 mg/day) or matched placebo for 12 weeks. Assessments were performed at baseline, 6 week, and 12 weeks. The primary outcome was change in menopausal symptom severity assessed using the Greene Climacteric Scale (GCS). Secondary outcomes included mood assessed using the Profile of Mood States (POMS), sleep quality using the Pittsburgh Sleep Quality Index (PSQI), and health-related quality of life using the Short Form-36(SF-36). Metabolic, endocrine, and safety parameters were also assessed. At week 12, total GCS scores decreased significantly more with Safr'Inside than with placebo, with mean reductions of 68% and 17%, respectively (p<0.0001). Improvements were already evident at week 6 and were most pronounced for psychological and somatic symptoms, including anxiety and depression. Night sweats significantly improved, while the overall vasomotor score showed a favourable trend (p=0.06). Saffron also improved negative mood, selected sleep-related outcomes and several dimensions of quality of life. Safr'Inside significantly reduced overall perimenopausal symptom burden, with benefits across psychological, somatic, mood, sleep-related, and selected vasomotor outcomes. These findings support further investigation of standardized saffron extract as a non-hormonal nutritional approach for perimenopausal symptom management.
papers.translated_summary: 更年期症状可能在围绝经期出现，包括心理、躯体、血管舒缩及睡眠相关障碍，可显著损害女性的身心健康与生活质量。藏红花（Crocus sativus L.）作为一种有前景的非激素营养干预手段而受到关注，对情绪健康和应激相关症状具有潜在益处。本研究评估了标准化藏红花提取物Safr'Inside在围绝经期女性中的有效性和安全性。这项多中心、随机、双盲、安慰剂对照试验纳入104名健康围绝经期女性（平均年龄：45.7±3.7岁），接受Safr'Inside（30 mg/天）或匹配安慰剂治疗12周。评估在基线、第6周和第12周进行。主要结局为使用Greene更年期量表（GCS）评估的更年期症状严重程度变化。次要结局包括使用心境状态量表（POMS）评估的情绪、使用匹兹堡睡眠质量指数（PSQI）评估的睡眠质量，以及使用健康调查简表-36（SF-36）评估的健康相关生活质量。同时评估代谢、内分泌及安全性参数。在第12周，Safr'Inside组GCS总分的下降幅度显著大于安慰剂组，平均降幅分别为68%和17%（p<0.0001）。改善在第6周即已显现，其中心理和躯体症状（包括焦虑和抑郁）最为明显。夜间盗汗显著改善，而整体血管舒缩评分呈现有利趋势（p=0.06）。藏红花还改善了负性情绪、部分睡眠相关结局及生活质量的若干维度。Safr'Inside显著降低了围绝经期整体症状负担，在心理、躯体、情绪、睡眠相关及部分血管舒缩结局方面均带来获益。这些发现支持进一步研究标准化藏红花提取物作为围绝经期症状管理的非激素营养干预手段。

papers.title: Characterizing the Emergence of Medetomidine in Southern California Fentanyl Markets
papers.translated_title: 表征南加州芬太尼市场中美托咪定的出现
papers.author: Koncsol, A. J.
papers.summary: Background: Medetomidine, a potent sedative, is increasingly present in fentanyl-related hospitalizations and deaths. Multiple states have passed legislation to control xylazine, a pharmacologically similar sedative in the illicit opioid supply. Medetomidine may function as a highly potent substitute for xylazine with significant overdose risk and withdrawal potential. Medetomidine has previously been described mostly in eastern U.S. fentanyl markets. Here, we characterize medetomidine-containing drug samples obtained in Southern California 2023-2026. Methods: Anonymous participants in Southern California voluntarily provided drug products to a community-based drug checking program. All samples underwent direct-analysis-in-real-time mass spectrometry (DART-MS). A subset was quantified by liquid-chromatography tandem mass spectrometry (LC-MS/MS). A smaller subset underwent enantiomeric analysis. We calculated other compounds co-present with medetomidine, the prevalence of medetomidine in fentanyl over time, the concentration of medetomidine, and the enantiomer makeup of medetomidine. Results: The quarterly prevalence of medetomidine co-present with fentanyl rose from {approx}6 % in May 2025 (month of first detection) to {approx}25 % by August 2026. The average medetomidine concentration was 0.4 % mass fraction. The most common co-detected substances with medetomidine were fentanyl and adulterants such as lidocaine and xylazine. All medetomidine samples that underwent enantiomeric analysis (n = 13) were identified as racemic. Conclusion: Medetomidine represents a rapidly emerging adulterant in the Southern California fentanyl supply. All samples assessed for enantiomer status were racemic medetomidine, suggesting they were not diverted from human pharmaceutical or medical supplies. Given its high potency, a small amount (<1.5%) is likely still a physiologically significant quantity of the drug.
papers.translated_summary: 背景：美托咪定是一种强效镇静剂，在芬太尼相关的住院和死亡病例中日益常见。多个州已通过立法管制赛拉嗪，这是一种在非法阿片类药物供应中具有药理相似性的镇静剂。美托咪定可能作为赛拉嗪的高效替代品发挥作用，具有显著的过量风险和戒断潜力。此前，美托咪定主要在美国东部的芬太尼市场中被描述。在此，我们对2023至2026年在南加州获得的含美托咪定药物样本进行了特征分析。方法：南加州的匿名参与者自愿向一个基于社区的药物检测项目提供药物产品。所有样本均经过实时直接分析质谱法（DART-MS）检测。一部分样本通过液相色谱-串联质谱法（LC-MS/MS）进行定量分析。更小一部分样本进行了对映体分析。我们计算了与美托咪定共存在的其他化合物、美托咪定在芬太尼中的流行率随时间的变化、美托咪定的浓度以及美托咪定的对映体组成。结果：与芬太尼共存在的美托咪定的季度流行率从2025年5月（首次检测月份）的约6%上升至2026年8月的约25%。美托咪定的平均浓度为0.4%质量分数。与美托咪定最常见的共检出物质为芬太尼及掺杂物如利多卡因和赛拉嗪。所有进行对映体分析的美托咪定样本（n=13）均被鉴定为外消旋体。结论：美托咪定是南加州芬太尼供应中一种快速新兴的掺杂物。所有评估对映体状态的样本均为外消旋美托咪定，表明它们并非来自人类药品或医疗用品的分流。鉴于其高效力，少量（<1.5%）很可能仍是具有生理意义的药物量。

papers.title: APOLLAI, a multimodal AI system, versus EMS personnel for prehospital detection of stroke-related deficits
papers.translated_title: APOLLAI，一种多模态人工智能系统，与急救人员相比，在院前检测卒中相关缺陷方面的表现
papers.author: Javault, C.
papers.summary: Background and Purpose: Prehospital stroke recognition remains suboptimal, with nearly one-third of strokes unidentified before hospital arrival, and neurological assessment being inherently subjective, with substantial interobserver variability even among certified clinicians. APOLLAI, a multimodal artificial intelligence system, was developed to detect stroke-related neurological deficits from video and audio recordings. We compared the diagnostic performance of APOLLAI and emergency medical services (EMS) personnel against an expert consensus reference standard. Methods: In this prospective study, video recordings of 295 patients with suspected stroke (mean age, 70.3 {+/-}13.3 years) were obtained at Nimes University Hospital (August 2023-July 2025). Five National Institutes of Health Stroke Scale items (best gaze, facial palsy, motor arm, aphasia, dysarthria) were independently annotated by seven certified stroke neurologists, combined into consensus labels using the Dawid-Skene algorithm, and separately assessed by EMS personnel (mean of 15 raters per patient). APOLLAI, a multimodal machine-learning framework that combines computer vision, audio-based deep learning, and a final support vector machine (SVM) fusion classifier, was evaluated against EMS using sensitivity, specificity, and the area under the receiver operating characteristic curve (AUC). Results: Interrater agreement among the seven neurologists was moderate overall (mean {kappa}=0.541, range, 0.367-0.732), indicating an intrinsic difficulty of neurological assessment. APOLLAI showed higher sensitivity than EMS for all five neurological tasks and for the global assessment (78.5% versus 59.4%), with broadly comparable specificity (87.0% versus 85.9% for the global assessment). AUC values ranged from 0.839 (facial palsy) to 0.966 (best gaze), with a global AUC of 0.882. Conclusions: APOLLAI demonstrated higher sensitivity than EMS personnel for detecting stroke-related neurological deficits, with preserved specificity. These findings support its potential as a standardized, scalable adjunct to prehospital stroke recognition, warranting prospective validation under real-world EMS conditions.
papers.translated_summary: 背景与目的：院前卒中识别仍不理想，近三分之一的卒中在到达医院前未被识别，且神经系统评估本质上具有主观性，即使在认证临床医生之间也存在显著的观察者间变异。APOLLAI是一种多模态人工智能系统，旨在从视频和音频记录中检测卒中相关神经功能缺损。我们将APOLLAI与急救医疗服务（EMS）人员的诊断性能与专家共识参考标准进行了比较。方法：在这项前瞻性研究中，于尼姆大学医院（2023年8月至2025年7月）获取了295例疑似卒中患者（平均年龄70.3±13.3岁）的视频记录。五个美国国立卫生研究院卒中量表条目（最佳凝视、面瘫、上肢运动、失语、构音障碍）由七名认证卒中神经科医生独立标注，使用Dawid-Skene算法合并为共识标签，并由EMS人员单独评估（每例患者平均15名评估者）。APOLLAI是一个多模态机器学习框架，结合了计算机视觉、基于音频的深度学习和最终的支持向量机（SVM）融合分类器，使用敏感性、特异性和受试者工作特征曲线下面积（AUC）与EMS进行比较评估。结果：七名神经科医生之间的评估者间一致性总体为中等（平均κ=0.541，范围0.367-0.732），表明神经系统评估存在内在困难。APOLLAI在所有五项神经功能任务和整体评估中均显示出高于EMS的敏感性（78.5%对59.4%），特异性大致相当（整体评估为87.0%对85.9%）。AUC值范围为0.839（面瘫）至0.966（最佳凝视），整体AUC为0.882。结论：APOLLAI在检测卒中相关神经功能缺损方面表现出高于EMS人员的敏感性，同时保持了特异性。这些发现支持其作为院前卒中识别的标准化、可扩展辅助工具的潜力，值得在真实世界EMS条件下进行前瞻性验证。

papers.title: Undeclared Kratom Alkaloids and Tianeptine in Products Labeled as Cat's Claw
papers.translated_title: 未申报的卡痛生物碱和噻奈普汀出现在标为猫爪草的产品中
papers.author: Avula, B.
papers.summary: Background: High-concentration 7-hydroxymitragynine (7-OH) products have been described by the US Food and Drug Administration as an emerging public health concern, and in August 2026 the Drug Enforcement Administration temporarily placed mitragynine pseudoindoxyl (MP), MGM-15 (dihydro-7-hydroxymitragynine), and MGM-16 in schedule I. Since July, Utah and Tennessee officials have reported overdoses, deaths, and laboratory findings involving tablets labeled as cat's claw (Uncaria tomentosa), an herbal supplement without known opioid activity. Chemical data on such products are scarce, and consumers cannot tell from the label which opioid-active compounds they contain. Methods: In a cross-sectional analysis, we purchased 46 chewable or unit-dose products labeled as containing cat's claw from online retailers and 3 gas stations in Mississippi during September 2026. The products represented 17 brands. Methanol extracts were analyzed by ultra-high-performance liquid chromatography with photodiode array detection and compared with a methanol extract of botanically verified U tomentosa bark. Liquid chromatography quadrupole time of flight mass spectrometry identified additional compounds, and compounds were quantified against authentic reference standards. Proportions are reported with exact (Clopper-Pearson) 95% CIs. Results: None of the 46 products declared kratom alkaloids or their derivatives, yet all contained at least one component. Mitragynine was quantified in 41 products (89%; 95% CI, 76% to 96%), 7-OH in 35 (76%; 95% CI, 61% to 87%), MGM-15 in 24 (52%; 95% CI, 37% to 67%), and MP in 22 (48%; 95% CI, 33% to 63%). A total of 39 products (85%; 95% CI, 71% to 94%) contained MP or MGM-15, which are temporarily controlled in schedule I. Tianeptine, an antidepressant not approved in the US, was present in five products (11%; 95% CI, 4% to 24%) at 27.9 to 40.2 mg per unit. The 7-OH content ranged from 0.01 to 95.4 mg per unit. Eight products carrying claims such as "NO KRATOM and No 7-OH" or "NO 7-OH" contained mitragynine, 7-OH, and 3-dehydromitragynine. Conclusions: Labels gave consumers no reliable guide to exposure. Clinicians evaluating unexplained opioid toxicity after use of a cat's claw product should consider kratom-derived opioids and tianeptine. Regulators may need product testing and label enforcement in addition to scheduling of individual compounds.
papers.translated_summary: 背景：美国食品药品监督管理局将高浓度7-羟基帽柱木碱（7-OH）产品描述为新兴公共卫生问题，2026年8月，美国缉毒局将帽柱木碱假吲哚酚（MP）、MGM-15（二氢-7-羟基帽柱木碱）和MGM-16临时列入附表I。自7月以来，犹他州和田纳西州官员报告了涉及标称为猫爪草（Uncaria tomentosa）的片剂的过量中毒、死亡和实验室发现，猫爪草是一种无已知阿片活性的草药补充剂。此类产品的化学数据稀少，消费者无法从标签判断其含有哪些阿片活性化合物。方法：在一项横断面分析中，我们于2026年9月从在线零售商和密西西比州3家加油站购买了46种标称含猫爪草的咀嚼或单剂量产品。这些产品代表17个品牌。甲醇提取物通过超高效液相色谱-光电二极管阵列检测进行分析，并与经植物学验证的U tomentosa树皮甲醇提取物进行比较。液相色谱四极杆飞行时间质谱鉴定了其他化合物，化合物对照真实参考标准品进行定量。比例报告精确（Clopper-Pearson）95% CI。结果：46种产品均未标示帽柱木碱类生物碱或其衍生物，但全部含有至少一种成分。41种产品（89%；95% CI，76%至96%）定量检出帽柱木碱，35种（76%；95% CI，61%至87%）检出7-OH，24种（52%；95% CI，37%至67%）检出MGM-15，22种（48%；95% CI，33%至63%）检出MP。共39种产品（85%；95% CI，71%至94%）含有MP或MGM-15，二者被临时列入附表I管制。噻奈普汀是一种未在美国获批的抗抑郁药，存在于5种产品中（11%；95% CI，4%至24%），每单位27.9至40.2 mg。7-OH含量范围为每单位0.01至95.4 mg。8种带有“NO KRATOM and No 7-OH”或“NO 7-OH”等声明的产品含有帽柱木碱、7-OH和3-脱氢帽柱木碱。结论：标签未能为消费者提供可靠的暴露指南。临床医生在评估使用猫爪草产品后出现的无法解释的阿片毒性时，应考虑帽柱木碱衍生阿片类和噻奈普汀。监管机构除对单个化合物进行列管外，可能还需要进行产品检测和标签执法。

papers.title: Standardized country-level delivery unit cost estimates for routine childhood, routine adolescent, and campaign vaccination: an updated modeling analysis
papers.translated_title: 常规儿童、常规青少年和运动疫苗接种的标准化国家层面交付单位成本估算：一项更新的建模分析
papers.author: Portnoy, A.
papers.summary: Background: Reliable estimates of immunization delivery costs are essential for planning, budgeting, and economic evaluation. Despite recent empirical studies, many low- and middle-income countries (LMICs) lack up-to-date cost estimates, particularly for adolescent and campaign vaccination. This study generated standardized country-level delivery cost estimates across vaccination modalities in LMICs. Methods: Using data from empirical costing studies in the 2024 update of the Immunization Delivery Cost Catalogue, we fitted Bayesian meta-regression models to estimate per-dose delivery costs, not including vaccine and injection supplies costs, for routine childhood vaccination, routine adolescent vaccination (using human papillomavirus vaccination as a proxy), and mass campaigns. Models incorporated country-level covariates (gross domestic product per capita, population size, diphtheria-tetanus-pertussis third-dose coverage, urbanization, population density, and under-five mortality) and study-level characteristics (cost category and costing perspective). Fitted models were used to generate country-specific and population-weighted mean economic and financial costs per dose in 2024 US dollars. Results: The analysis included 141 observations for routine childhood, 49 for adolescent, and 104 for campaign vaccination. The population-weighted mean full economic cost per dose across LMICs was $4.27 (95% prediction interval: $1.95-11.58) for routine childhood vaccination, $20.56 ($8.56-57.83) for adolescent vaccination, and $14.71 ($4.90-86.98) for campaigns. Corresponding estimates for incremental economic costs per dose were $16.64 ($7.90-38.22), $20.43($8.27-47.78), and $3.53 ($1.70-8.56). Substantial heterogeneity was observed across countries, delivery modalities, and cost perspectives. Conclusions: Leveraging an expanded evidence-base and Bayesian meta-regression, this study provides updated delivery cost estimates across vaccination modalities for 136 LMICs. These estimates offer a practical resource for analyses where empirical cost data are unavailable.
papers.translated_summary: 背景：可靠的免疫接种服务成本估算对于规划、预算编制和经济评价至关重要。尽管近期已有实证研究，但许多低收入和中等收入国家（LMICs）仍缺乏最新的成本估算，尤其是青少年疫苗接种和运动式疫苗接种方面。本研究在LMICs中按疫苗接种模式生成了标准化的国家层面服务成本估算。方法：利用《免疫接种服务成本目录》2024年更新版中的实证成本研究数据，我们拟合了贝叶斯元回归模型，以估算常规儿童疫苗接种、常规青少年疫苗接种（以人乳头瘤病毒疫苗接种作为代理）和群体性运动的每剂服务成本，不包括疫苗和注射用品成本。模型纳入了国家层面协变量（人均国内生产总值、人口规模、白喉-破伤风-百日咳第三剂覆盖率、城市化率、人口密度和五岁以下儿童死亡率）和研究层面特征（成本类别和成本核算视角）。拟合模型用于生成以2024年美元计的国家特定和人口加权平均每剂经济成本和财务成本。结果：分析纳入常规儿童疫苗接种141个观测值、青少年疫苗接种49个观测值和运动式疫苗接种104个观测值。LMICs中人口加权平均每剂完全经济成本为：常规儿童疫苗接种4.27美元（95%预测区间：1.95-11.58美元），青少年疫苗接种20.56美元（8.56-57.83美元），运动式疫苗接种14.71美元（4.90-86.98美元）。每剂增量经济成本的相应估算分别为16.64美元（7.90-38.22美元）、20.43美元（8.27-47.78美元）和3.53美元（1.70-8.56美元）。在不同国家、接种模式和成本视角之间观察到显著异质性。结论：本研究利用扩展的证据基础和贝叶斯元回归，为136个LMICs提供了跨疫苗接种模式的更新服务成本估算。这些估算为无法获得实证成本数据的分析提供了实用资源。
